scene.detail: Actual registered BodyParts3D thorax and existing Lead Placement Lab markers. Patient-right/left refer to the patient; front-view viewer left is patient RIGHT. The 50 source meshes include skin, sternum, clavicles, 12 rib pairs, costal cartilage and pectoralis; no heart, lungs, cable hardware or full limbs are present. Chest positions and intercostal overlays are derived reference-atlas teaching anchors, not measurements for an individual. The four limb labels point toward external limb regions, not validated diagnostic recording sites. This is a static anatomical/polarity lesson, with no ECG signal, contact-impedance or vector-projection solver. Lead RA/LA are electrode labels, not right/left atria. Any visible RL “GND” is the existing module’s teaching shorthand: the right-leg electrode commonly provides a common reference/driven-right-leg function; it is not a positive/negative measurement pole or necessarily literal earth ground. The unused RA/LA/LL electrode is never reassigned as ground. The skin sensor is represented only by a teaching placement marker; contact mechanics and hardware are not modeled.

scene.title: Reliable contact and a still subject
scene.text: Good recordings depend on reliable skin contact, secure electrodes, correct positions, and a relaxed, still subject.
scene.source: Owner-approved adapted M07.06 narration · source script lines 446-479;480-505 · course PDF physical pp243,247–248,257–258,264
scene.qualification: Supplemental explanation; no corresponding 3D process, instrument measurement, generated tracing or clinical prediction. No skin contact, adhesive behavior or signal-quality process is modeled.

scene.title: Recording artifacts
scene.text: Movement, muscle activity, loose contacts, and electrical interference can distort a tracing.
scene.source: Owner-approved adapted M07.06 narration · source script lines 446-479;480-505 · course PDF physical pp243,247–248,257–258,264
scene.qualification: Supplemental explanation; no corresponding 3D process, instrument measurement, generated tracing or clinical prediction. No motion, muscle-noise, contact-loss or mains-interference tracing is generated.

scene.title: Small and biphasic complexes
scene.text: A near-perpendicular net vector can produce a small or biphasic complex.
scene.source: Owner-approved adapted M07.07 narration · source script lines 446-453;480-519 · course PDF physical pp244–245,267,338
scene.qualification: Supplemental explanation; no corresponding 3D process, instrument measurement, generated tracing or clinical prediction. No net-vector projection, biphasic waveform or caliper measurements are generated.

scene.title: An isoelectric segment
scene.text: An isoelectric segment does not prove that every heart cell is electrically inactive.
scene.source: Owner-approved adapted M07.07 narration · source script lines 446-453;480-519 · course PDF physical pp244–245,267,338
scene.qualification: Supplemental explanation; no corresponding 3D process, instrument measurement, generated tracing or clinical prediction. No tracing is displayed or measured; a near-flat surface recording does not establish cellular inactivity.

scene.title: Opposing signals and little net change
scene.text: Opposing signals or little net change can also produce a near-flat line.
scene.source: Owner-approved adapted M07.07 narration · source script lines 446-453;480-519 · course PDF physical pp244–245,267,338
scene.qualification: Supplemental explanation; no corresponding 3D process, instrument measurement, generated tracing or clinical prediction. A net electrical comparison can be small despite active cells; no quantitative cancellation solver is present.

scene.title: Adult frontal QRS axis reference
